title: skill-store global manifest (<store>/global.manifest.json)
description: Skills linked into the user-level Claude Code skills directory ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills or ~/.claude/skills) by 'skill-store --global'. Lives in the store, never in the Claude config dir. Same fields as the project manifest; the cap is separate from every project's.

cap.description: Maximum number of store skills linked globally at once. Default 8. Linking beyond it unlinks the least recently used globally linked skill.

skills.description: Skill names, in the order they were added (earlier = older; used to break LRU ties).
